local.decisionRule: One pooled 1000-game sample with rejection-only <50% looks at 300/500; final pass only at >=55% of 1000. No early pass, extensions, retuning or retries.

process.timingCaveat: The failed turn has no completed response time. sendMs includes host input preparation/write/flush; consumerMs includes host-side consumption timing. The observed long send cannot be attributed solely to bot CPU or allocation behavior.

limitations: A local pass cannot override strict submitted-process failure or replace a valid cached-boss stage.
Observed process failure includes host input preparation/write/flush timing and cannot be attributed solely to bot CPU.
Allocation reduction and bit-exact ample-time behavior do not prove CG timing or arena improvement.
Historical V3 results on different maps do not measure a paired V5-vs-V3 gain.
